description: This file defines a C# class JwtTokenGenerator that implements token creation using JWT for authentication purposes within the application. It constructs JWT tokens with claims such as subject, issued at, and JWT ID, using configured issuer options.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating JWT tokens based on provided issuer options and username.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a JWT token string for the specified username.
